summary: Retained supervisor records from the madmax release-builder guests now time the actual 1.3.1 world (2058 s), kernel (240 s), release sets (444 s) and ISO assembly (426 s), each with UTC start/terminal pairs and exact source or full product/ports/source selection checks; package build has only failed or non-producing attempts, and package fetch and signing were not recovered. scripts/release-measurements.py --recover-supervisor validates every record and keeps them historical-observation, so no stage is comparison-eligible for a normalized speedup.
